observations.title: Recover inventory from a death gravestone
observations.player_action: After an ordinary death, return to the automatically created gravestone and recover stored inventory.
observations.outcome: The mod preserves items against normal despawn or lava loss.
conditions: Upstream/native documentation is evidence, not a verified JEM gameplay rule; installed configuration and JEM overrides may differ.
